original: [ 앤 아주머니 ]/n어서오세요, 수고가 많군요. 무엇을 찾고 있지요?
chinese_reference: [ 安大婶 ]/n欢迎，辛苦了。您想找什么？
target: [ Aunt Anne ]/nWelcome. You've been working hard. What are you looking for?
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 안녕히, 그리고 몸 건강히 임무를 수행하시길...
chinese_reference: 再见，祝您平安健康地完成任务……
target: Farewell, and may you carry out your mission safely...
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 우리 제피르 팰컨의 가게의 물건가격은 대단히 쌉니다. 뭐, 기본적인 것은 배급되기 때문에 그다지 살 필요도 없지만...
chinese_reference: 我们西风之隼商店的物价很低。不过，基本物资都会配发，其实也没多少东西需要买……
target: Prices in our Zephyr Falcon shop are very low. Of course, basic supplies are issued to us, so there's little we need to buy...
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 파는 가격이 높은 곳이라면 이곳에서 사서 그곳에서 팔아도 꽤 괜찮지 않을까?
chinese_reference: 要是别处收购价高，从这里买了再拿去卖，应该也能赚不少吧？
target: If we found somewhere that paid higher prices, couldn't we make a tidy profit buying here and selling there?
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 우리 제피르 팰컨의 성공은 적절한 시민선동에 힘입은 바가 상당히 큽니다. 이에 있어서는 클라우제비츠님의 선동전술이 잘 먹힌 셈 이지요.
chinese_reference: 西风之隼的成功，很大程度上得益于对民众的有效动员。这方面，克劳塞维茨先生的宣传战术确实奏效了。
target: Much of Zephyr Falcon's success is due to effective agitation among the people. Lord Clausewitz's tactics have worked very well in that regard.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 시민들이 고통을 받고 있는 것은 사실이지만, 그들을 적절히 일깨워 주지 않으면 그들은 자신들이 고통받고 있다는 사실조차 망각하기 일쑤죠.
chinese_reference: 民众受苦是事实，但若不适时唤醒他们，他们往往连自己正在受苦都忘记了。
target: The people are suffering, but unless someone wakes them up to it, they often forget that they're suffering at all.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 니코시아 지방은 카라카스 숲을 통해 게이시르 시티를 경유하여 남쪽으로 내려가야 합니다.
chinese_reference: 前往尼科西亚地区，需要穿过加拉加斯森林，经盖西尔城继续向南。
target: To reach Nicosia, go through Caracas Forest and Gaysir City, then head south.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 이곳의 동쪽에는 프리토리아 지방이 있고/n그 동쪽에는 카라카스 지방이 있습니다.
chinese_reference: 这里东面是普雷托利亚地区，/n再往东就是加拉加斯地区。
target: Pretoria lies east of here,/nand Caracas lies east of that.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 리브레빌지방은 카라카스 숲에서 북쪽으로 가야 합니다.
chinese_reference: 前往利伯维尔地区，要从加拉加斯森林向北走。
target: To reach Libreville, head north from Caracas Forest.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 카라카스 숲은 교통의 요지로 리브레빌,게이시르시티,파로,프리토리아를 연결해 주고 있습니다.
chinese_reference: 加拉加斯森林是交通要地，连接着利伯维尔、盖西尔城、帕罗和普雷托利亚。
target: Caracas Forest is a major crossroads linking Libreville, Gaysir City, Paro, and Pretoria.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 대륙남부에 있는 멤피스,보르도,로우엔등을 가기 위해서는 게이시르 시티를 거쳐가야 합니다.
chinese_reference: 前往大陆南部的孟菲斯、波尔多、罗恩等地，都要经过盖西尔城。
target: To reach Memphis, Bordeaux, Lowen, and the other southern regions, you must go through Gaysir City.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 이곳은 우리 제피르 팰컨의 메인 아지트 입니다. 겉으로 보기에는 평범한 동굴 같지만...
chinese_reference: 这里是我们西风之隼的主要基地。外表看起来只是个普通洞穴，不过……
target: This is Zephyr Falcon's main hideout. From outside, it looks like an ordinary cave...
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 이곳 프리토리아 근방의 숲은 이상한 소문이 많이돌기 때문에 사람들이 거의 접근하지 않습니다.
chinese_reference: 普雷托利亚附近的这片森林，流传着很多奇怪的传闻，所以几乎没人靠近。
target: There are so many strange rumors about this forest near Pretoria that people rarely come near it.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 이곳은 다카마항, 대 팬드래건 왕국의 무역항입니다.
chinese_reference: 这里是达卡马港，大潘德拉根王国的贸易港。
target: This is Dakama Harbor, a trading port of the great Kingdom of Pendragon.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 당신같은 외국인은 도시 내부로는 들어갈수 없을 것입니다.
chinese_reference: 像您这样的外国人，恐怕不能进入城内。
target: Foreigners like you won't be allowed into the city itself.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 이번 항해에는 해적이나 폭풍을 만나지 말아야 할텐데...
chinese_reference: 希望这次航行别遇上海盗或风暴……
target: I hope we don't run into pirates or storms on this voyage...
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 이곳에서 다카마로 가는 배를 탈 수 있다고 들었습니다.
chinese_reference: 听说可以在这里乘船去达卡马。
target: I heard I could catch a ship to Dakama here.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: [ 선장 ]/n그렇소. 그렇지만 요새 다카마로 가는 항로는 대단히 위험하기 때문에 우리도 출항을 연기하고 있는 상황이요.
chinese_reference: [ 船长 ]/n是的。不过，最近前往达卡马的航路非常危险，所以我们也推迟了出航。
target: [ Captain ]/nThat's right. But the route to Dakama is extremely dangerous lately, so we've delayed our departure.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: [ 선장 ]/n 그렇소 우리도 지금으로서는 언제 출항을 할 수 있을지 의문이지.
chinese_reference: [ 船长 ]/n没错。如今连我们自己也不知道什么时候才能出航。
target: [ Captain ]/n That's right. Even we don't know when we'll be able to sail now.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 이곳은 다카마항, 대 펜드래건 왕국의 무역항입니다.
chinese_reference: 这里是达卡马港，大潘德拉根王国的贸易港。
target: This is Dakama Harbor, a trading port of the great Kingdom of Pendragon.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 이곳은 다카마항, 대 펜드래건 왕국의 무역항입니다.
chinese_reference: 这里是达卡马港，大潘德拉根王国的贸易港。
target: This is Dakama Harbor, a trading port of the great Kingdom of Pendragon.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 회의실은 우리 제피르 팰컨 기지중에서 가장 화려한 장식이 된 방입니다.
chinese_reference: 会议室是我们西风之隼基地里装饰最华丽的房间。
target: The meeting room is the most lavishly decorated room in our Zephyr Falcon base.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 현재 우리 제피르 팰컨의 사기는 최고조입니다만, 적들도 점점 더 강해지는 것 같습니다.
chinese_reference: 我们西风之隼现在士气高昂，不过敌人似乎也越来越强了。
target: Zephyr Falcon's morale is at an all-time high, but our enemies seem to be growing stronger too.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 특히나 로우엔의 프레데릭 장군의 군대는 정말 상대하기가 어렵습니다.
chinese_reference: 尤其是罗恩的弗雷德里克将军麾下的军队，实在很难对付。
target: General Frederick's army in Lowen is particularly difficult to fight.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 가끔가다 주점 벽 한편에서 이상한 소리가 들려오는 경우가 있습니다. 술에 너무 취해서 그런가?
chinese_reference: 有时会听见酒馆的一面墙里传来奇怪的声音。是我喝得太醉了吗？
target: Sometimes I hear strange noises from one of the tavern walls. Am I drinking too much?
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 제피르 팰컨에 들어오기 전에는 저는 카라카스에서 좀도둑질을 했었지요. 하지만 지금은 완전히 손을 씻을 상태입니다.
chinese_reference: 加入西风之隼以前，我在加拉加斯做过些小偷小摸的事。不过，现在已经彻底洗手不干了。
target: Before I joined Zephyr Falcon, I was a petty thief in Caracas. But I've gone completely straight now.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 흥... 저녀석이 손을 씻었다는 것은 메주를 콩으로 쑨다고 해도 안 믿을 겁니다.
chinese_reference: 哼……那家伙说自己洗手不干，就算他说太阳从东边升起，我也不信。
target: Hmph... Him, gone straight? I wouldn't trust a word out of his mouth, even if he told me the sun rose in the east.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 요새 내무반에서 없어지는 물건은 꼭 저녀석이 돈을 받고 팔고 있다고요.
chinese_reference: 最近兵舍里丢的东西，准能看见那家伙拿出来卖。
target: Whenever something goes missing from the barracks lately, that fellow ends up selling it.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 우리 제피르 팰컨의 명성은 드높고 사기는 하늘을 찌를 듯 합니다.
chinese_reference: 我们西风之隼声名远扬，士气更是高涨。
target: Zephyr Falcon's fame is spreading, and our morale is soaring.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 우리는 이제 단순한 복수 집단이나 의적정도가 아닌 이 제국의 변혁을 위한 단체인 것입니다.
chinese_reference: 如今，我们不再只是复仇者或义贼，而是要为这个帝国带来变革的组织。
target: We're no longer just a band of avengers or noble outlaws. We're an organization working to transform this empire.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 로우엔의 프레데릭 경의 군대는 정말로 상대하기 싫은 군대입니다. 그들의 정예 사수는 정확한 발포와 겨냥을 하고, 그들의 검사의 손은 매섭지요.
chinese_reference: 罗恩的弗雷德里克大人的部队，是我最不愿碰上的对手。他们的精锐射手瞄得准、打得稳，剑士的身手也十分凌厉。
target: Lord Frederick's army in Lowen is one force I'd rather not face. Their elite marksmen aim and fire with precision, and their swordsmen are formidable.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 사실, 다른 영주도 그와 같다면 우리가 존재할 이유가 없겠죠. 안그렇습니까..
chinese_reference: 说真的，要是其他领主也像他那样，我们就没有存在的必要了。不是吗……
target: In fact, if all the other lords were like him, there'd be no reason for us to exist. Would there...?
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 제가 이곳에 들어온 것은 우리가족 전체가 몰살당했기 때문이지. 그것도 영주한테...
chinese_reference: 我会加入这里，是因为全家都被杀光了。而且，下手的还是领主……
target: I joined because my entire family was slaughtered. By our own lord, no less...
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 나는 오직 복수의 일념만으로 살아오고 있어. 그 일념마저 없었다면 이곳에서 살아갈 이유가 없지...
chinese_reference: 我一直只为复仇而活。如果连这个念头也没了，我也就没有活下去的理由了……
target: I've lived for revenge alone. Without that, I'd have no reason to go on living...
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 제피르 팰컨의 이름이 드높아지면서 점점 이곳저곳에서 견제를 많이 받게되는 것이 문제라면 문제입니다.
chinese_reference: 随着西风之隼的名声越来越响，各方对我们的牵制也越来越多，这算是眼下的难题吧。
target: As Zephyr Falcon's reputation grows, more and more groups are trying to hold us in check. That's becoming a problem.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 어쩌면 우리는 실제 이상으로 명성이 올라가 있는것인지도 모르겠습니다.
chinese_reference: 也许我们的名声，已经超出了实际的实力。
target: Perhaps our reputation has outgrown our actual strength.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 주점에서는 가끔 이상한 소리가 들리곤 합니다. 저는 별로 술을 많이 마시는 편이 아닌데 불구하고...
chinese_reference: 酒馆里偶尔会传来奇怪的声音。我明明也没喝多少酒……
target: Sometimes I hear strange noises in the tavern, even though I don't drink very much...
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 마치 주점 건너편에 무엇인가 있는 듯 하게 느껴질 때가 있어요... 정말 이상하지요?
chinese_reference: 有时感觉酒馆的另一边好像藏着什么……是不是很奇怪？
target: At times, it feels like there's something on the other side of the tavern... Strange, isn't it?
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 우리 여자들도 제피르 팰컨의 일원으로 한사람 몫을 충분히 합니다. 이곳에서는 남녀 차별이 없지요. 단적으로 부대장님중 절반이 여성 아닙니까?
chinese_reference: 我们女性也是西风之隼的一员，同样能独当一面。这里没有男女之分。最明显的例子，不就是部队长有一半都是女性吗？
target: We women pull our weight as members of Zephyr Falcon too. There's no discrimination here. Just look: aren't half our unit commanders women?
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 곰곰히 생각해 보면, 우리 제피르 팰컨을 만들었다는 총수는 어떤 사람인지 전혀 알려져 있지 않아.
chinese_reference: 仔细想想，我们对创立西风之隼的那位首领，竟然一无所知。
target: When you think about it, we know nothing about the leader who founded Zephyr Falcon.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 어떤 사람이었을까? 자신도 역시 교회에 가문이 멸망당한 몰락귀족일까? 안그러면 평민 출신일까?
chinese_reference: 会是什么样的人呢？也是家族被教会毁掉的没落贵族吗？还是平民出身？
target: What kind of person could it be? A fallen noble whose family was destroyed by the Church? Or someone born a commoner?
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 어제 내무반에 들어가 보니 내 물건이 몇개 없어져 있더군.
chinese_reference: 昨天回到兵舍，我发现自己的东西少了几件。
target: When I went back to the barracks yesterday, a few of my things were missing.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 한참 찾는데 그 물건이 내무반 블랙마켓에서 거래되고 있다는 것을 알았어.
chinese_reference: 找了好久才知道，那些东西居然在兵舍的黑市里被拿来买卖。
target: After searching for ages, I found out they were being sold on the barracks black market.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 빌어먹을... 난 어떤놈이 내 물건을 훔쳐다가 팔아버렸는지 알 것 같지만, 물증이 없어.
chinese_reference: 该死……我大概知道是谁偷了我的东西拿去卖，可就是没有证据。
target: Damn it... I think I know who stole my things and sold them, but I have no proof.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 도데체 클라우제비츠님의 수첩에는 무엇이 적혀 있을까?
chinese_reference: 克劳塞维茨先生的笔记本里，到底写着些什么？
target: What on earth does Lord Clausewitz write in his notebook?
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 그 유명한 클라우제비츠님의 수첩이요? 무엇이 적혀 있는지는 아무도 모른답니다.
chinese_reference: 你说克劳塞维茨先生那本有名的笔记本？没人知道里面写了什么。
target: Lord Clausewitz's famous notebook? No one knows what's written in it.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 혹시, 우리 여자 대원들의 신상목록 같은 것을 적어두시는 것은 아니겠지요?
chinese_reference: 该不会是在记录我们女队员的个人资料吧？

original: 자, 제국의 무궁한 발전과 영광을 위하여! 우리는 모든 사람의 힘을 모으는 응집핵이 될 수 있다고!
chinese_reference: 来，为帝国永恒的繁荣与荣光干杯！我们能成为凝聚所有人力量的核心！
target: A toast to the empire's everlasting prosperity and glory! We can become the force that brings everyone together!
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 흥... 과연 우리가 제국의 역사를 바꾸어 놓을 수 있을까?
chinese_reference: 哼……我们真能改变帝国的历史吗？
target: Hmph... Can we really change the empire's history?
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 난 단지 내 개인적인 복수를 위해서 이 집단에 몸을 담고 있을 뿐이야. 제국의 국민을 위해? 흐흐흐...
chinese_reference: 我加入这个组织，只是为了自己的复仇。为了帝国的人民？嘿嘿嘿……
target: I only joined this organization for my own revenge. For the people of the empire? Heh heh heh...
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 이 근처에서 가끔가다 이상한 소리가 들리는 경우가 있어요. 환청인가...?
chinese_reference: 这附近偶尔会传来奇怪的声音。难道是幻听……？
target: Sometimes I hear strange noises around here. Am I imagining things...?
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 아무래도 요새 지나치게 술을 마시는 것 같아요. 술을 마시고 이곳 문을 나설때면 귀가 찡 하는 것이 기분이 이상해서...
chinese_reference: 看来最近喝得太多了。每次喝完酒走出这扇门，耳朵就嗡的一响，感觉很奇怪……
target: I must be drinking too much lately. Whenever I leave this door after a drink, my ears ring and I feel strange...
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 내 친구 한놈이 벽 뒤로 빨려들어간 적이 있어요. 물론 내가 너무 취해서 헛것을 본 것일 테지만, 진짜로 진짜같았거든...
chinese_reference: 我有个朋友曾经被吸进墙后面。当然，也许是我喝得太醉看花了眼，可那一幕实在太真了……
target: I once saw a friend get sucked through the wall. Of course, I must have been drunk and seeing things, but it looked so real...
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 이곳은 다카마항, 대 팬드래건 왕국의 무역항입니다.
chinese_reference: 这里是达卡马港，大潘德拉根王国的贸易港。
target: This is Dakama Harbor, a trading port of the great Kingdom of Pendragon.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 이곳에서 다카마로 가는 배를 탈 수 있다고 들었습니다.
chinese_reference: 听说可以在这里乘船去达卡马。
target: I heard I could catch a ship to Dakama here.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: [ 선장 ]/n 그렇소 우리도 지금으로서는 언제 출항을 할 수 있을지 의문이지.
chinese_reference: [ 船长 ]/n没错。如今连我们自己也不知道什么时候才能出航。
target: [ Captain ]/n That's right. Even we don't know when we'll be able to sail now.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 니코시아 지방은 카라카스 숲을 통해 게이시르 시티를 경유하여 남쪽으로 내려가야 합니다.
chinese_reference: 前往尼科西亚地区，需要穿过加拉加斯森林，经盖西尔城继续向南。
target: To reach Nicosia, go through Caracas Forest and Gaysir City, then head south.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 이곳의 동쪽에는 프리토리아 지방이 있고/n그 동쪽에는 카라카스 지방이 있습니다.
chinese_reference: 这里东面是普雷托利亚地区，/n再往东就是加拉加斯地区。
target: Pretoria lies east of here,/nand Caracas lies east of that.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 리브레빌지방은 카라카스 숲에서 북쪽으로 가야 합니다.
chinese_reference: 前往利伯维尔地区，要从加拉加斯森林向北走。
target: To reach Libreville, head north from Caracas Forest.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 카라카스 숲은 교통의 요지로 리브레빌,게이시르시티,파로,프리토리아를 연결해 주고 있습니다.
chinese_reference: 加拉加斯森林是交通要地，连接着利伯维尔、盖西尔城、帕罗和普雷托利亚。
target: Caracas Forest is a major crossroads linking Libreville, Gaysir City, Paro, and Pretoria.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 대륙남부에 있는 멤피스,보르도,로우엔등을 가기 위해서는 게이시르 시티를 거쳐가야 합니다.
chinese_reference: 前往大陆南部的孟菲斯、波尔多、罗恩等地，都要经过盖西尔城。
target: To reach Memphis, Bordeaux, Lowen, and the other southern regions, you must go through Gaysir City.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 이곳은 우리 제피르 팰컨의 메인 아지트 입니다. 겉으로 보기에는 평범한 동굴 같지만...
chinese_reference: 这里是我们西风之隼的主要基地。外表看起来只是个普通洞穴，不过……
target: This is Zephyr Falcon's main hideout. From outside, it looks like an ordinary cave...
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 이곳 프리토리아 근방의 숲은 이상한 소문이 많이돌기 때문에 사람들이 거의 접근하지 않습니다.
chinese_reference: 普雷托利亚附近的这片森林，流传着很多奇怪的传闻，所以几乎没人靠近。
target: There are so many strange rumors about this forest near Pretoria that people rarely come near it.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: [ 앤 아주머니 ]/n어서오세요, 수고가 많군요. 무엇을 찾고 있지요?
chinese_reference: [ 安大婶 ]/n欢迎，辛苦了。您想找什么？
target: [ Aunt Anne ]/nWelcome. You've been working hard. What are you looking for?
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 안녕히, 그리고 몸 건강히 임무를 수행하시길...
chinese_reference: 再见，祝您平安健康地完成任务……
target: Farewell, and may you carry out your mission safely...
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 우리 제피르 팰컨의 가게의 물건가격은 대단히 쌉니다. 뭐, 기본적인 것은 배급되기 때문에 그다지 살 필요도 없지만...
chinese_reference: 我们西风之隼商店的物价很低。不过，基本物资都会配发，其实也没多少东西需要买……
target: Prices in our Zephyr Falcon shop are very low. Of course, basic supplies are issued to us, so there's little we need to buy...
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 파는 가격이 높은 곳이라면 이곳에서 사서 그곳에서 팔아도 꽤 괜찮지 않을까?
chinese_reference: 要是别处收购价高，从这里买了再拿去卖，应该也能赚不少吧？
target: If we found somewhere that paid higher prices, couldn't we make a tidy profit buying here and selling there?
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 우리 제피르 팰컨의 성공은 적절한 시민선동에 힘입은 바가 상당히 큽니다. 이에 있어서는 클라우제비츠님의 선동전술이 잘 먹힌 셈 이지요.
chinese_reference: 西风之隼的成功，很大程度上得益于对民众的有效动员。这方面，克劳塞维茨先生的宣传战术确实奏效了。
target: Much of Zephyr Falcon's success is due to effective agitation among the people. Lord Clausewitz's tactics have worked very well in that regard.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.

original: 시민들이 고통을 받고 있는 것은 사실이지만, 그들을 적절히 일깨워 주지 않으면 그들은 자신들이 고통받고 있다는 사실조차 망각하기 일쑤죠.
chinese_reference: 民众受苦是事实，但若不适时唤醒他们，他们往往连自己正在受苦都忘记了。
target: The people are suffering, but unless someone wakes them up to it, they often forget that they're suffering at all.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. NPC political opinions and directions retained. Korean bean-paste credibility idiom localized. Minor names provisional.
